interaction: 背包中央展示完整物品网格。点击物品后使用独立详情弹窗。

design.layout: 居中大窗，四个分类标签，全宽物品格，底部关闭按钮，右上角独立关闭按钮。
design.style: 森林遗迹、深绿皮革底、胡桃木标题、柔和金边、少量藤叶与青绿宝石。
design.entry: 深绿金边方形按钮，棕色皮革背包、搭扣和卷起的地图。
design.exampleGrid: 参考图采用 8 列 × 3 行展示，表示视觉排布。
design.illustrativeContent: 物品图标、名称、数量和勾选状态用于构图示意，展示格数不定义背包容量。正式文本与数据由游戏配置提供。

outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone inventory / backpack entry button reference asset for DiceLand, a hand-painted 2D Chinese fantasy forest adventure RPG. runtimeAssets.usage: Shared map, event, and rest-scene inventory entry. Original RGBA artwork, imported as a sprite.

implementation.layout: Centered full-width collection, 2–8 adaptive columns, scrolling without a capacity limit; separate existing item details and equipment action.
implementation.motion: Unscaled 0.24s opening, 0.16s closing, 0.16s category fade; icon hover and press feedback; backdrop blocks input until closing finishes.

validation.MCP: Rendered map inventory at 2340x1080, 1920x1080 details and 1600x1200 tablet layout. Verified event layering and rest-scene entry/open UI in disposed preview scenes. Rest play test clicks the authored scene entry and confirms equipment persistence without consuming the visit.
